_comment: Two kinds of missing reference, so both halves of the schema-driven walk are pinned. content_scripts names missing.js, a key the old hand-written list covered. icons names icon.png at two sizes, a key it did NOT - a manifest declaring an icon it does not ship was reported by nothing. Both sizes are listed because whether a file is packaged is a property of the slot, and the two slots anchor at their own manifest lines.
